title: Evaluate and recommend tech stack for mxo-track platform
description: Comprehensive evaluation of technology choices for the mxo-track logistics platform covering backend, real-time, storage, mobile, dashboard, messaging, mapping, DevOps, and language strategy.
acceptance_criteria: Evaluate backend framework options (keep Hono vs alternatives)
Recommend real-time communication strategy (SSE, WebSocket, etc.)
Define storage strategy compatible with file-based architecture
Recommend mobile app framework for driver app
Evaluate message queue / event system options
Define mapping and geo strategy for routing and geocoding
Decide on full TypeScript vs polyglot approach
